get.description:
Read precomputed team analytics from the materialized table.

The heavy aggregation (150-line CTE over plays + schedules) used to run
on every request. It now runs once during ingest and writes to the
`team_season_analytics` table; this endpoint is a simple keyed SELECT.

If the row is missing (fresh DB, never-ingested season), the builder
lazily materializes on first hit so the system self-heals.

post.description: Non-streaming answer (used by the eval and as a simple fallback).

Server-Sent Events: streams the tool-call chain and the answer tokens as
the agent works. Validation + rate limit run before the stream opens; errors
that surface mid-stream (auth, upstream) arrive as an `error` event, since
the HTTP status is already committed once streaming starts.

get.description:
Review the data gaps the assistant has logged — questions it couldn't
fully answer because the platform is missing that stat/split/season.

CombineData.title: CombineData
CombineData.description:
One row per combine participant. Heights are recorded as '6-2' strings
by the source; we leave them as strings for display rather than coercing.

DefensiveSplit.title: DefensiveSplit
DefensiveSplit.description:
A defender's event line (tackles/sacks/TFL/QB hits/INT/PBU/FF)
conditioned on one situational dimension. Counts only — nflfastR has no
coverage data. Scrimmage plays only (special-teams tackles have no down).
Served by /players/{id}/def-splits.

DepthChartEntry.title: DepthChartEntry
DepthChartEntry.description:
A depth-chart slot. depth_team is "1"/"2"/"3", where "1" is the
starter at that depth_position. The vendor feed is a daily snapshot:
season is derived from the snapshot date and week is always null.

DraftInfo.title: DraftInfo
DraftInfo.description:
One row per drafted player from `draft_picks`. Career achievement
fields (`probowls`, `allpro`, `car_av`) come pre-aggregated from PFR.

Game.title: Game
Game.description: A scheduled game; scores are null for unplayed games.

GameDetail.title: GameDetail
GameDetail.description: Game detail returned by /games/{id}: game header + rosters + scoring + WP.

GamePlayerStats.title: GamePlayerStats
GamePlayerStats.description:
Per-game player line returned in /games/{id} under away[] / home[].

Stat columns come back as DOUBLE from DuckDB (DEFAULT 0), so they are
floats even when conceptually counts (touchdowns, attempts, etc.).

InjuryStatus.title: InjuryStatus
InjuryStatus.description:
A weekly injury report entry. We surface the most recent one for a
player on the player view; a list for team/game views.

KickingStats.title: KickingStats
KickingStats.description:
Per-season kicker/punter splits derived from play-by-play — sparse by role.

Raw counts/totals are stored (not pre-computed rates) so the frontend can
aggregate a career row by simple summation and recompute averages against
the season-total attempt/punt counts it already has.

LeagueLeader.title: LeagueLeader
LeagueLeader.description:
One row per player in /leaders. Stat fields are season totals from
SUM() over player_game_stats, returned as DOUBLE.

All stat fields are required-and-non-null: the underlying columns have
DEFAULT 0, so SUM(...) is always a number (0.0 for non-applicable
stats like RB pass_yards). Roster-joined fields (position/team) may be
null because the join is LEFT and roster data can be missing.

LiveGameOut.title: LiveGameOut
LiveGameOut.description:
A game as the live tier reports it.

Deliberately an overlay rather than a second copy of `Game`: it carries
`game_id`, so the client merges it onto the cards it already has instead of
learning a parallel vocabulary for the same fixture.

NgsStats.title: NgsStats
NgsStats.description:
Next Gen Stats per season. Fields populated depend on role.

NOTE: unlike most of our models, these sub-views are genuinely sparse —
a QB row only has passing fields, a WR row only has receiving fields.
The helper builds the dict from non-null SELECT results, so absent
fields mean "doesn't apply." Defaults are kept so each instance can
carry any subset.

PlayerAdvStats.title: PlayerAdvStats
PlayerAdvStats.description: Per-season advanced stats — sparse by player role.

PlayerAward.title: PlayerAward
PlayerAward.description:
A single major award win for a player.

Sourced from the seeded `player_awards` table — major postseason
voting awards: MVP, OPOY, DPOY, OROY, DROY, CPOY. Joined back to
rosters on (player_name, season) during ingest so each row carries
the player's gsis_id when available.

PlayerGame.title: PlayerGame
PlayerGame.description: One row in the player's game log.

PlayerSplit.title: PlayerSplit
PlayerSplit.description:
One row of a player's stat line conditioned on a single situational
dimension. Long-format: (season, category, split_dim, split_value) +
metrics. Served by /players/{id}/splits, grouped client-side by dim.

PlayerWpa.title: PlayerWpa
PlayerWpa.description: Per-season WPA attribution. Sparse by role (passer/rusher/receiver).

RosterPlayer.title: RosterPlayer
RosterPlayer.description: A player on a team's roster for a given season.

ScheduleWeek.title: ScheduleWeek
ScheduleWeek.description: A week of games returned by /schedule.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description: A single search hit. `type` discriminates player vs team.

SituationalStats.title: SituationalStats
SituationalStats.description: Per-season situational splits — sparse by design. See NgsStats note.

SnapTotals.title: SnapTotals
SnapTotals.description:
Per-season snap counts. snap_counts SQL always returns every column,
just NULL where the player has no snaps of that type.

TeamAnalyticsResponse.title: TeamAnalyticsResponse
TeamAnalyticsResponse.description: /team-analytics?season=… returns the season plus per-team rows.

TeamAnalyticsRow.title: TeamAnalyticsRow
TeamAnalyticsRow.description:
One row per team. Rank columns are 1-based with 1 = best (for that team).

Higher-is-better metrics use DESC ranks; lower-is-better metrics use ASC,
so rank=1 always means "best in the league" regardless of metric direction.

Most rate metrics can legitimately be NULL (e.g. PROE is NULL for seasons
before nflfastR added pass_oe; rz_td_pct is NULL for teams that never
reached the red zone), so all of them are required-but-nullable.

TeamGame.title: TeamGame
TeamGame.description:
A team's schedule row inside /teams/{team}. Records walked forward
by attach_records() are required (always set on this endpoint).

TeamGameStats.title: TeamGameStats
TeamGameStats.description: Team-level box-score line for one game, computed from play-by-play.

TeamLeader.title: TeamLeader
TeamLeader.description:
Per-player season totals for one team. Returned twice on /teams/{team}:
once for regular season (leaders), once for playoffs (playoff_leaders).

TeamSplit.title: TeamSplit
TeamSplit.description:
One row of a team's rate profile conditioned on a situational dimension.
Long-format: (side, split_dim, split_value) + rate metrics. Served by
/teams/{team}/splits, grouped client-side by side + dim.

WpaLeader.title: WpaLeader
WpaLeader.description:
One row in passing/rushing/receiving WPA leaders.

The volume column (attempts/carries/receptions) varies per sub-list.
Only one is populated per row — the others are simply absent from
the SQL projection, so they remain optional + None.
